    n = len(h)

```
import cvxpy as cp
def solve_milp_binary(n, time_limit):
    M = n // 2  # assume n even
    h = cp.Variable(n, boolean=True)
    # T real variable
    T = cp.Variable()
    constraints = [cp.sum(h) == M,
                   T >= 0]
    # Build product variables p[ℓ][i]
    p_vars = []
    for ell in range(1, n):
        p_ell = cp.Variable(n - ell, boolean=True)  # for i=0...n-ell-1
        # constraints linking p_ell to h
        constraints += [p_ell <= h[:n-ell],
                        p_ell <= h[ell:],
                        p_ell >= h[:n-ell] + h[ell:] - 1]
        # Sum constraints
        constraints.append(cp.sum(p_ell) + T >= M)
        p_vars.append(p_ell)
    objective = cp.Minimize(T)
    prob = cp.Problem(objective, constraints)
    prob.solve(solver=cp.CBC, verbose=False, maxTime=time_limit)  # maybe param timeLimit
```

```
def evaluate_h(h):
    n = len(h)
    dx = 2.0 / n
    H = np.fft.rfft(h, n*2)
    G = np.fft.rfft(1 - h, n*2)  # conj for potential reversal difference
```
